name: router-demo
description: Roku showcase for flash-theater's router surface — router.navigate/back/params/backJourneyData, directional focus (router.isBackJourney + focus(<id>)), router-outlet transitions (navigate-out:/navigate-in:/back-out:/back-in:), and the loading gate (loadingComponent + router.markReady()) — a focused, one-mechanic-per-chapter deep dive into the router itself, unlike every other chapter app where the router is just plumbing for chapter-to-chapter navigation (see findings/demo-app-conventions.md).

scripts.build:roku: npm run compile && npm run zip
